-----------------

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. We focus relentlessly on guaranteeing availability and reliability at scale. The team delivers business growth generating capacity and services at industry-leading intervals. Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

Title: Network Operations Senior Advisor (Network Operations)
Description:
Job Posting Location: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

**Position Objective:**

The Senior Advisor serves as the principal strategic and technical sounding board to the VP of Network Operations. Orchestrating operational excellence across all network domains and drive the transition from a complex legacy infrastructure to a future-state, zero-touch architecture – targeting TM Forum Autonomous Network Level 4 (ANL 4) maturity and a modernized, unified NOC.

**Job Description & Responsibilities:**

* Act as the primary trusted advisor to the VP of Network Operations on long-term strategy, operational risk management, and technology lifecycle investments.
* Evaluate and translate emerging technological trends (e.g., 6G readiness, advanced edge computing, network slicing) into actionable, high-yield operational roadmaps.
* Advise on the governance of operational frameworks across the entirety of the operator’s footprint to ensure alignment with global standards and corporate KPIs.
* Provide strategic direction and operational efficiency oversight across eight core domains:
* Mobile Network: Next-gen RAN, vRAN, OpenRAN, and multi-generation (4G/5G/5G-Advanced) core alignment.
* Fixed Network: FTTx, GPON, and next-generation fixed access operations.
* Transport Network: IP/MPLS, Optical (DWDM), Segment Routing, and microwave backhaul optimization.
* Core & Cloud Network: Cloud-native network functions (CNFs/VNFs), telco cloud infrastructure (OpenStack, Kubernetes), and hybrid-cloud operational paradigms.
* IT Operations: Alignment of corporate IT infrastructure, workplace tech, and data center operations with network functions.
* Cybersecurity: Embedding DevSecOps into network operations, ensuring infrastructure resilience, threat mitigation, and strict regulatory compliance.
* OSS/BSS: Transforming legacy Operations and Business Support Systems into agile, microservices-driven architectures.
* AIOps Strategy Formulation: Define the overarching AI/ML roadmap for Network Operations to move toward predictive, generative, and closed-loop autonomous operations.
* AIOps Implementation: Drive the deployment of Artificial Intelligence for AI Operations (AIOps) platforms to ingest vast streams of telemetry data across Fixed, Mobile, and Cloud networks for real-time anomaly detection and predictive scaling.
* Generative AI & LLMs in Ops: Evaluate and pilot Generative AI applications (such as LLM-powered network assistants) to accelerate Tier-1/Tier-2 engineering troubleshooting, synthesize complex RCA (Root Cause Analysis) logs, and automate routine configuration scripts safely.
* Data Governance for Networks: Collaborate with Chief Data Officers/IT to establish robust data pipelines, ensuring clean, structured, and real-time network telemetry data is available to train and mature AI models.
* AI Governance & Explainability: Ensure AI/ML and closed-loop automation decisions remain auditable and explainable (XAI), preserving engineer trust and regulatory compliance as autonomy increases.
* AI Capability Upskilling: Act as a change agent to foster an AI-first mindset across the engineering workforce, advising the VP on the talent and skills gap required to operate a cognitive network.
* Lead the transformation of the NOC from siloed, domain-specific monitoring into a unified command center, consolidating EMS/NMS, service assurance, and orchestration tooling across Fixed, Mobile, Transport, Core, Cloud, and IT domains.
* Define and continuously optimize the NOC’s tiered support structure (Tier 0 automated remediation through Tier 3 specialist escalation), shifting resolution through automation, runbooks, and AI-assisted diagnostics.
* Drive AI/ML-based event correlation, event de-duplication, and noise reduction, ensuring NOC engineers focus exclusively on actionable, service-impacting events.
* Own the end-to-end Major Incident Management process, including rapid triage, cross-domain war-room coordination, executive communication, and post-incident root-cause and problem management.
* Ensure 24/7 operational resilience through effective staffing model, shift patterns, and escalation matrices that sustain continuous, around-the-clock network assurance aligned with contractual SLA commitments.
* NOC-SOC Integration: Partner with the Cybersecurity function to align NOC monitoring and incident-response workflows with Security Operations Center (SOC) processes, ensuring unified visibility into service-impacting and security-impacting events.
* Progress the NOC toward TM Forum Autonomous Network Level 4 (ANL 4) — highly autonomous, closed-loop operations — with measurable maturity targets across priority domains.
* ANL Level 4 Transition: Architect and drive the migration from manual/reactive troubleshooting to Autonomous Advanced Operations Model Level 4 (Intent-driven, highly autonomous closed-loop operations).
* Zero-Touch Self-Healing: Recommend, design, and champion AI/ML-driven initiatives to achieve predictive maintenance, automated anomaly detection, and automated root-cause analysis (RCA) to enable a self-healing infrastructure.
* OPEX Optimization: Identify structural inefficiencies across domains and execute modernization programs that significantly reduce operational costs while boosting Network Quality of Experience (QoE).
* Energy & Sustainability Optimization: Drive AI-based optimization of RAN and site power usage to cut energy cost, reduce emissions, and improve operational efficiency.
* Align all operational transformation workflows, information models, and open APIs with TM Forum Open Digital Architecture (ODA) - including eTOM, SID, and the Functional Framework to enable vendor-agnostic interoperability and support zero-touch, AI-ready operations.
* Enforce and mature the FCAPS (Fault, Configuration, Accounting, Performance, Security) model through modern, automated tooling.

**Qualifications & Experience:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Electronic Engineering, Computer Science, or a strictly related technical field is required.
* A Master’s Degree (M.Sc. or MBA) is highly preferred
* Minimum of 20 years of progressive experience within the Telecommunications or closely related ICT sector.
* At least 5 years in a similar executive advisory capacity, or a senior management role within a Tier-1 telecom operator.
* Documented history of leading large-scale network transformation, automation, or modernization initiatives that yielded measurable OPEX savings or reliability gains.
* Deep understanding of complex network ecosystems (Fixed, Mobile, Transport, Core, IT, Cyber).
* Demonstrated experience leading or transforming a large-scale, 24/7 Network Operations Center (NOC), including tiered escalation models, major incident management, and modern NOC tooling (EMS/NMS, ITSM/ticketing, alarm correlation, AIOps platforms).
* Comprehensive knowledge of TM Forum Open Digital Architecture (ODA) — including eTOM, SID, and the Functional Frameworkand traditional FCAPS infrastructure management.
* Comprehensive knowledge of AI/ML applications in telecom operations (AIOps), network virtualization (NFV/SDN), and orchestration engines.
* Industry certifications and memberships (e.g., PMP, ITIL, TOGAF, CCIE, or equivalent) are considered a plus
* Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to distill highly technical, fragmented architectural issues into clear, risk-managed business cases for C-suite executives and cross-functional teams.
* Ability to balance immediate operational fire-fighting with the long-term vision of proactive and zero-touch autonomy.
* Strong adaptability and a drive for continual improvement.
* Experience in time management and task prioritization.
* Excellent verbal and written English; Arabic is an advantage.
* Strong organizational skills and ability to perform under pressure without compromising quality.

Title: Manager, IT Infrastructure Center of Excellence
Description:
**Job Description**
**Job Title:**
Manager, IT Infrastructure Center of Excellence
  
  
**Reporting To:**
Director, Information Technology Infrastructure & Services Delivery
  
  
**Business Unit / Function:**
Pr ocurement & Business Support
  
  
**Department:**
Information Technology
  
  
**Why This Role Matters**
Lead infrastructure technical excellence through standards, solution design, and engineering across Maaden sites. Translate approved IT direction into reliable, scalable infrastructure and reusable capabilities. Enable IT Services Delivery to operate and support services effectively, while keeping day-to-day operations and enterprise strategy ownership with the accountable teams.
  
  
**What You Will Deliver**
Manage the infrastructure Center of Excellence for networks, systems, datacenters, and databases. Provide technical requirements, design assurance, engineering guidance and knowledge transfer, aligned with enterprise architecture and the Director’s approved priorities.
  
  
**Contract Strategy and Governance**
Develop infrastructure standards, reference architectures, and technology roadmaps within enterprise architecture principles. Define technical specifications and acceptance criteria for infrastructure solutions and sourcing. Govern technology selection, standard configurations, and lifecycle plans, including upgrades, refresh, and retirement. Assess emerging technologies for business fit, interoperability, capacity, and supportability. Recommend designs and exceptions through established architecture authorities; enterprise policy and strategy remain with the accountable leaders .
  
  
**Contract Administration and Compliance**
Maintain design documentation, configuration baselines, and engineering procedures. Govern and oversee infrastructure projects within delegated authority, coordinating with PMO and IT Services Delivery on scope, delivery plans, milestones, budgets, risks, dependencies, architecture and standards compliance, acceptance, and transition to operations. Review supplier deliverables against agreed specifications and standards. Coordinate design assurance, testing, and operational handover with IT Services Delivery, including support documentation and knowledge transfer. Verify that designs address integration, availability, capacity, recovery, and maintainability before transition. Document technical deviations and corrective actions and escalate non-compliance through the responsible governance and contract owners.
  
  
**Contractor Performance Management**
Assess suppliers’ technical deliverables and engineering quality against agreed requirements. Define and monitor infrastructure service level agreements (SLAs) and key performance indicators (KPIs) in coordination with IT Services Delivery and relevant stakeholders; review performance against agreed targets, report deviations and drive corrective actions and continual design improvement. Use recurring-problem evidence from IT Services Delivery to inform engineering improvements. Develop infrastructure automation and DevOps engineering practices with delivery teams to improve repeatability and reduce manual work. Coach technical staff, share reusable designs and strengthen internal engineering capability. Daily operations, service support, and operational supplier SLA management remain with IT Services Delivery
  
  
**Commercial and Cost Management**
Develop capacity and lifecycle recommendations using utilization, availability, and technology requirements. Evaluate infrastructure options for standardization, reuse, and cost efficiency. Provide technical input to procurement, project estimates, and purchase requisitions within assigned responsibility; escalate funding and commercial decisions to the authorized owners. Manage and oversee infrastructure contracts, particularly the Infrastructure & Service Delivery managed service provider contract, within delegated authority and in coordination with Procurement, Legal, IT Services Delivery and relevant stakeholders. Validate technical scope, deliverables and SLAs/KPIs; oversee contractual compliance, performance reviews, escalations, corrective actions, changes, renewals, and exit/transition planning. Contract approvals remain with authorized signatories, and day-to-day operational ownership remains with IT Services Delivery.
  
  
**Risk, HSE and Business Continuity**
Define infrastructure resilience, backup and recovery design requirements with business continuity, security, and delivery teams. Support disaster recovery planning and testing; review technical findings and track engineering improvements. Apply relevant site HSE requirements during infrastructure work and escalate risks. Backup operations, incident response, and service restoration remain with IT Services Delivery.
  
  
**What Success Looks Like**
Infrastructure designs meet agreed standards and business requirements; documented handovers enable effective support. Roadmaps address capacity, lifecycle, and resilience needs. Technical assurance findings are resolved, or formally escalated, recurring issues inform engineering improvements, and delivery teams can reuse documented designs and procedures. Performance targets are agreed through the established management process.
  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**
Bachelor’s degree in computer science or computer engineering. ITIL Foundation and ISO 20000-1 service management certification (preferred)
  
  
**Experience**
8–10 years of experience in IT service management, infrastructure, and end-user services, with practical technical requirements, infrastructure project, and standards experience. Good understanding of ITIL and ISO 20000 service management frameworks.
  
  
**Skills That Matter**
Infrastructure planning and technical documentation; analytical diagnosis and problem solving; emerging technology assessment; continuous improvement; stakeholder collaboration and communication; planning and prioritization; people leadership and capability development. Translate operational needs into clear technical specifications and explain design recommendations to technical and management audiences

Backup operations, incident response, and service restoration remain with IT Services Delivery.

**What Success Looks Like**

Infrastructure designs meet agreed standards and business requirements; documented handovers enable effective support. Roadmaps address capacity, lifecycle, and resilience needs. Technical assurance findings are resolved, or formally escalated, recurring issues inform engineering improvements, and delivery teams can reuse documented designs and procedures. Performance targets are agreed through the established management process.

**Minimum Qualifications**

Bachelor’s degree in computer science or computer engineering. ITIL Foundation and ISO 20000-1 service management certification (preferred)

**Experience**

8–10 years of experience in IT service management, infrastructure, and end-user services, with practical technical requirements, infrastructure project, and standards experience. Good understanding of ITIL and ISO 20000 service management frameworks.

**Skills That Matter**

Infrastructure planning and technical documentation; analytical diagnosis and problem solving; emerging technology assessment; continuous improvement; stakeholder collaboration and communication; planning and prioritization; people leadership and capability development. Translate operational needs into clear technical specifications and explain design recommendations to technical and management audiences

Description:

Atos also provides consulting and advisory services through its Atos Amplify brand.
  
  
A trusted partner in operating complex and mission-critical environments, Atos supports organizations across highly regulated and sovereign contexts.
  
  
**About Atos Group**
Atos Group is a global leader in digital transformation with c. 54,000 employees and annual revenue of c. €7.2 billion, operating in 54 countries under two brands - Atos for services and Eviden for products and systems. European number one in cybersecurity and a leader in cloud, Atos Group is committed to a secure and decarbonized future and provides tailored AI-powered, end-to-end solutions for all industries. Atos Group is listed on Euronext Paris.
  
  
Senior Director, Client Delivery & Operations
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
Atos is seeking a
**Senior Director, Client Delivery & Operations**
to lead the North American client delivery organization. Reporting directly to the Chief Operating Officer, this executive will be accountable for the operational performance, service delivery execution, customer experience, and financial health of a large, multi-practice delivery organization supporting more than
**$1 billion in annual business**
and a workforce of more than
**1,000 delivery professionals**
.
  
  
This leader will oversee a broad and complex portfolio that includes managed infrastructure services, compute, data center, network, cloud, cybersecurity, applications, digital workplace, application management services, staff augmentation, project-based delivery, and long-term managed services. The role requires a leader who understands the operational and commercial differences between time-and-materials engagements, project delivery, and managed services, and who can establish a consistent delivery model across them.
  
  
The Senior Director will serve as the delivery organization’s primary service provider to Atos account and client leadership teams. While this individual will not directly own customer accounts, they will be accountable for ensuring that the services promised to customers are delivered effectively, consistently, and profitably. The role will work closely with account teams, practice leaders, and business-line executives to align delivery capabilities with customer requirements and business commitments.
  
  
This leader will establish common operating practices, strengthen collaboration across business lines, clarify ownership, and modernize delivery through automation, artificial intelligence, and innovative operating models.
  
  
Success will require significant experience leading large-scale technology delivery organizations, strong commercial and financial acumen, executive presence, and the ability to drive accountability across a complex matrixed environment. The successful candidate must be comfortable leading through organizational change and operational uncertainty, stabilizing customers in crisis, challenging legacy approaches, and making difficult decisions while maintaining the trust of customers, employees, and executive stakeholders.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Enterprise Client Delivery Leadership
  
  

* Own overall service delivery execution across the North American client delivery organization.
* Provide leadership across an organization of more than 1,000 delivery professionals supporting a business portfolio exceeding $1 billion annually.
* Ensure consistent achievement of contractual commitments, service-level agreements, operational targets, customer outcomes, quality standards, and financial objectives.
* Establish clear accountability for delivery performance across practices, business lines, and service portfolios.
* Create a culture of operational excellence, customer focus, transparency, urgency, and disciplined execution.
* Partner with practice leaders and account teams to identify and mitigate delivery risks before they affect customers.
* Serve as the senior executive escalation point for significant delivery, service, operational, and customer issues.
* Lead the stabilization and recovery of complex or distressed customer engagements, including situations involving service disruption, performance deterioration, delivery breakdowns, or customer dissatisfaction.
* Ensure delivery leaders maintain effective operational governance across both long-term customers and new or transitioning engagements.

Shared Delivery and Service Integration
  
  

* Lead an integrated delivery model encompassing staff augmentation, time-and-materials engagements, project-based delivery, and managed services.
* Align delivery across infrastructure, cloud, cybersecurity, digital workplace, applications, application management services, compute, data center, and network services.
* Ensure customers experience one coordinated Atos delivery organization, regardless of the technologies, business lines, or delivery teams involved.
* Establish standardized operating procedures governing service transitions, work transfers, escalations, ownership boundaries, resource deployment, and cross-practice collaboration.
* Eliminate operational silos and reduce delays, ownership confusion, inconsistent practices, and failed handoffs between service areas.
* Define clear roles and decision rights among practice operations, account leadership, client management, solution teams, and delivery organizations.
* Resolve organizational friction, competing priorities, and operational conflicts that impede customer delivery.
* Preserve the technical expertise of individual practices while aligning them around common customer and business outcomes.

Financial and Business Performance
  
  

* Own the financial and operational performance of the North American client delivery organization.
* Drive improvements in margin, productivity, utilization, scalability, delivery quality, and cost efficiency.
* Partner with practice leaders, account leaders, finance, workforce management, and portfolio owners to optimize staffing, capacity, location strategy, and workforce planning.
* Maintain an effective balance between customer commitments, service quality, employee capacity, and profitability.
* Identify structural cost, productivity, and delivery-model improvements that strengthen the performance of the existing book of business.
* Support revenue retention and growth by increasing customer confidence, improving service consistency, and strengthening delivery credibility.
* Establish performance metrics, operating reviews, executive dashboards, and corrective-action mechanisms that provide transparency across the organization.
* Hold leaders accountable for operational commitments, financial performance, risk mitigation, and sustainable improvement.

Customer Experience and Service Excellence
  
  

* Ensure delivery decisions are driven by customer impact rather than internal organizational boundaries.
* Improve customer satisfaction, service quality, responsiveness, reliability, and delivery consistency.
* Partner with account and client leadership teams to understand customer priorities and translate them into executable delivery plans.
* Provide delivery expertise and operational support to account teams without displacing their commercial ownership of the customer relationship.
* Improve the organization’s ability to anticipate customer concerns and resolve issues before they become executive escalations.
* Build strong relationships with senior customer stakeholders during critical delivery situations, service recoveries, and major transformations.
* Reinforce accountability for the entire customer outcome rather than individual service towers, practices, or contractual components.
* Use customer feedback, operational data, service trends, and root-cause analysis to drive measurable improvements.

Transformation, Automation, and AI
  
  

* Develop and execute a transformation roadmap for the North American delivery organization.
* Modernize legacy processes, governance structures, and delivery practices to improve speed, consistency, and accountability.
* Advance the use of AI, automation, analytics, and intelligent operations across service delivery.
* Identify opportunities to reduce manual effort, accelerate issue resolution, improve service predictability, and enhance the customer experience.
* Establish scalable operating models that support multiple service types, technologies, and customer environments.
* Promote greater use of standardized tools, processes, controls, and performance data.
* Lead the organization through a period of significant change while maintaining service continuity and customer confidence.
* Position the delivery organization to operate successfully in an increasingly AI-enabled technology services market.

Organizational and Practice Leadership
  
  

* Provide leadership and direction to practice and delivery leaders responsible for specialized service portfolios.
* Build a cohesive leadership team aligned around shared customer, operational, and financial objectives.
* Establish clear expectations and hold leaders accountable for results.
* Develop succession plans and strengthen the organization’s delivery, operational, and customer-leadership capabilities.
* Create an environment that rewards collaboration, transparency, responsible decision-making, and enterprise-wide thinking.
* Challenge internal behaviors and legacy structures that prioritize practice interests over customer outcomes.
* Communicate a clear transformation vision and translate that vision into measurable operating priorities.
* Bring energy, resilience, and visible leadership to a large organization navigating substantial operational and market change.

**Required Qualifications**

* Approximately 15 or more years of progressive leadership experience in technology services, client delivery, operations, managed services, or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience leading a large, complex delivery organization, preferably involving more than 1,000 employees or delivery professionals.
* Significant experience overseeing an annual business portfolio, delivery organization, or P&L approaching or exceeding $1 billion.
* Experience operating across multiple technology domains, such as managed infrastructure, cloud, cybersecurity, digital workplace, applications, application management services, compute, data center, and network services.
* Proven understanding of staff augmentation, time-and-materials engagements, project-based delivery, and managed services operating models.
* A successful record of leading service transformation, organizational integration, operating-model redesign, or enterprise delivery modernization.
* Demonstrated ability to manage complex customer escalations, distressed engagements, operational crises, and service-recovery programs.
* Strong financial and commercial acumen, including experience with margin improvement, utilization, workforce planning, productivity, cost management, and P&L performance.
* Experience leading through a matrixed organization in which delivery, practices, account teams, sales, finance, and customer leadership have interconnected responsibilities.
* Ability to understand a broad technology services portfolio sufficiently to make sound operational decisions and lead specialized practice executives.
* Executive-level communication, stakeholder-management, negotiation, and conflict-resolution capabilities.
* Willingness to challenge established practices, address performance issues, and make difficult decisions when customer or business outcomes are at risk.
* Demonstrated judgment, self-awareness, resilience, and leadership maturity.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, technology, engineering, or a related discipline; an advanced degree is preferred.

Leadership Profile
  
  
The successful candidate will be
  
  

* Customer-centered Consistently prioritizes customer outcomes over internal structures and organizational boundaries.
* Operationally rigorous Establishes clear standards, measures performance, and maintains consistent accountability.
* Transformational Challenges legacy approaches and converts a broad modernization vision into executable change.
* Crisis-tested Remains composed and decisive during major customer, service, and organizational challenges.
* Commercially grounded Understands how delivery quality, cost, customer confidence, and profitability affect one another.
* Enterprise-minded Leads across the entire delivery organization rather than advocating for a single practice or technology tower.
* Influential Aligns senior stakeholders and specialized leaders without relying solely on organizational authority.
* Energetic and resilient Brings visible momentum to a large organization operating through significant change.
* Self-aware Understands their impact on others, listens to competing perspectives, and adjusts appropriately without compromising accountability.
* Decisive Makes timely, evidence-based decisions and accepts responsibility for outcomes.

Location and Travel
  
  
This position may be based anywhere in the United States, with the Irving, Texas area preferred. The role is expected to require occasional travel of up to approximately 25 percent
  
  
The base compensation range for this role is $250,000 – $300,000 USD.

The compensation range listed for this position reflects the minimum and maximum target compensation that Atos, in good faith, believes it may pay for the role at the time of this posting. This range may be subject to change as permitted by law.
  
  
The actual compensation offered to any candidate may fall outside the posted range and will be determined based on multiple factors permitted by applicable law. These may include, but are not limited to, geographic location, education and qualifications, certifications and licenses, relevant experience and skills, seniority and performance, market and business considerations, and internal pay equity.

Title: AI Infrastructure System Engineering - Team Lead
Description:
We are seeking a Systems Support Engineering Team Lead to support the AI server deployment process. In this role, you will be the primary operational point of contact for triaging and resolving issues during software and hardware deployment. You will monitor incoming tickets, diagnose software-related deployment bottlenecks, and collaborate with hardware and networking teams to ensure smooth deployment workflows. The ideal candidate possesses a mix of system administration, basic networking, and hardware troubleshooting knowledge, along with a strong background in Linux environments.
  
  
CIeNET Canada welcomes skilled, dedicated, innovative, and motivated professionals to join our team and build a promising career with us.
  
  
**Requirements**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Team Management: Serve as the team lead responsible for coordinating triage operations of the daily System Support Engineering team, including prioritization and validation of issue fixes.
* Follow-the-Sun Handoff PoC: Provide a daily summary of issue triage and resolution support, with clear parameters for escalation and prioritization.
* Frontline Support: Act as the escalation point for automated deployment pipelines and installation scripts.
* Deployment Issue Triage: Monitor, investigate, and manage incoming tickets generated during the hardware and software bootstrapping phases.
* Log & Metric Analysis: Dive into installer logs, operating system metrics, and orchestration workflow histories to determine why a deployment or hardware qualification step failed including:
* Software Diagnosis: Investigate, diagnose, and resolve software-related deployment failures, containerization glitches, or configuration issues (e.g., DHCP, PXE boot, network services).
* Hardware & Firmware Escalation: Identify issues rooted in faulty hardware, outdated firmware, or physical networking constraints, and efficiently route/escalate them to the appropriate hardware engineering or data center technician teams.
* Documentation & Continuous Improvement: Update runbooks, diagnostic playbooks, and error resolution guides to streamline future deployment.
* Collaboration: Act as the bridge between software development, DevOps, and hardware operations teams to drive rapid resolution of blockers

**Required Skills & Qualifications**
**Technical Skills:**

* Linux/OS Administration: Strong proficiency navigating, troubleshooting, and diagnosing issues in Linux environments.
* Networking Fundamentals: Good understanding of IP networking, DNS, DHCP (DHCPv4/DHCPv6), and network diagnostics.
* Hardware & Firmware Knowledge: Familiarity with server components, BMCs (Baseboard Management Controllers), BIOS, and basic physical infrastructure (NICs, switches).
* Containerization & Orchestration: Practical experience troubleshooting in Kubernetes environments (e.g., K3s, custom distributions), CNI plugins, and workload scheduling.
* Ticketing & Tracking Systems: Experience using ticket systems to manage, escalate, and organize operational tasks

**Soft Skills:**

* Team Leadership: Strong leadership and team management ability.
* PoC Management and Communication: Effective communicator and the ability to develop and maintain relationships with customer PoC's in partner engineering teams.
* Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to distinguish between software/configuration issues and physical hardware failures.
* Incident Management: Ability to work well under time-sensitive deployment deadlines (Tier 2 response environments).
* Cross-Timezone Collaboration: Ability to pass off tasks smoothly to global counterparts at the end of a shift (handoff reporting)

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bootstrap/Deployment Experience: Experience with netboot/PXE installation processes, or unattended server installation setups.
* Containerization & Orchestration: Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, or workflow orchestration tools.
* Automation/Scripting: Ability to write or interpret basic scripts (Bash, Python) to assist with automated diagnostics.
* DCIM/IPAM Tools: Prior experience working with tools like NetBox or other DCIM/Inventory management systems

**Education And Experiences**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field
* 2+ years of computer networking experience
* 2+ years of Linux Operating System experience

* Extended group insurance including prescription drugs, dental and vision cares
* RRSP employer match
* 15 days annual vacation

Title: Director, IT Infrastructure & Operations
Industry: Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage
Description:
**Job Description**
The Director, IT Infrastructure and Operations leads the teams that keep Liquidity Services’ technology operating reliably every day: Platform Operations, Network Engineering, and Service Desk and Field Support. This role is accountable for the reliability, security, scalability, and cost-effectiveness of end-user support; server, identity, collaboration, backup, and storage platforms across on-premises, Azure, and AWS environments; and the hybrid network that connects offices, retail locations, warehouse facilities, cloud environments, and remote users. As a hands-on technical leader, the Director sets operational standards and service levels, serves as the senior escalation point for infrastructure and network issues, builds and develops the team, manages vendors and budgets, and leads modernization efforts in partnership with Information Security, DevOps, application teams, and business leaders. Based in the Dallas area, the Director works on-site at the Richardson, TX office several days a week and serves as the senior IT operations leader for that location.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Service availability: Uptime of critical infrastructure, network, and end-user services meets defined targets.
* Service Desk performance: Response time, resolution time, first-contact resolution, backlog, and employee satisfaction meet agreed service levels.
* Security and compliance: Servers, endpoints, and network devices are kept current on security patches, vulnerabilities are remediated on schedule, and infrastructure controls pass PCI and SOX audits.
* Resilience: Backups and disaster recovery are tested regularly and meet defined recovery goals.
* Modernization delivery: The infrastructure and network roadmap is executed on schedule and within budget, including removing the dependency on Cisco cloud services routers and delivering new facility builds and site upgrades.
* Financial management: Infrastructure, cloud, telecom, and support spending is managed within budget, with measurable licensing, cloud, and vendor cost savings.
* Team strength: Strong retention, development, and coverage of critical skills across all three teams.
* Lead, manage, and develop the Platform Operations, Network Engineering, and Service Desk and Field Support teams, including hiring, goal setting, performance management, coaching, and succession planning.
* Set the strategy and multi-year roadmap for end-user support, infrastructure, and network services, aligned with business priorities, security requirements, and the company’s cloud direction.
* Oversee Service Desk and Field Support operations through the Service Desk Director, including field services across offices, retail locations, and warehouse facilities, and set expectations for service levels, escalation paths, staffing and coverage models, and self-service and knowledge-management practices.
* Own the implementation, delivery, and support of enterprise server and identity platforms, including Windows Server, virtualization platforms, Active Directory, Entra ID (Azure AD), ADFS, and DNS/DHCP.
* Own the Microsoft 365 collaboration stack, including Exchange Online, SharePoint, and Teams, and the endpoint management platforms that support it.
* Oversee cloud infrastructure across multiple Azure regions and the AWS environment, in partnership with DevOps and application teams.
* Own backup and disaster recovery using Rubrik and Azure Site Recovery, including regular recovery testing, documentation, and business continuity planning.
* Govern enterprise file shares and data storage policies, including retention, PII, access, and user roles, with regular access and integrity audits in partnership with Information Security.
* Drive cloud cost optimization with Server, Development, DevOps, and Database teams using native cloud cost tools.
* Oversee the hybrid network environment, including Cisco and Meraki switching and wireless, Palo Alto firewalls and VPN, WAN and internet connectivity, and the program to replace Cisco cloud services routers with cloud-native connectivity between Azure, AWS, and company sites.
* Own infrastructure and network monitoring and alerting (such as PRTG and Datadog), so that issues are detected and resolved before they affect the business.
* Lead IT delivery for new facilities, expansions, relocations, and site upgrades, coordinating network, infrastructure, end-user equipment, and Service Desk readiness.
* Establish and run IT service management processes, including incident, problem, change, configuration, asset, and request management; lead major-incident response and post-incident reviews, and serve as the senior escalation point for infrastructure issues.
* Serve as the primary liaison between Platform Operations and the Security and Site Reliability (SSRE) team; partner with Information Security on patching, vulnerability remediation, access controls, logging, and segmentation, and support PCI, SOX, and other audit and control requirements.
* Define operational metrics and dashboards, and report service performance, risks, and project status to IT leadership and business stakeholders.
* Develop and manage the infrastructure, cloud, network, telecom, and support budgets; drive cost optimization across licensing, cloud consumption, carriers, and hardware.
* Manage relationships with key vendors, carriers, managed service providers, and contractors; partner with the Contracts team on negotiations, renewals, and service-performance reviews.
* Champion automation, standardization, and documentation to improve reliability and reduce manual work.
* Serve as the senior IT infrastructure leader on-site at the Richardson, TX office and as the escalation point for after-hours critical incidents.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**

* Team or Function Manager: This position manages a team or function and is responsible for hiring, performance management, employee development, and ensuring work is completed in alignment with organizational objectives.
* Directly manages the leaders and senior individual contributors responsible for Platform Operations, Network Engineering, and Service Desk and Field Support, including the Service Desk Director who leads help desk and field support technicians.
* Provides second-level leadership for help desk analysts and field support technicians, ensuring consistent service levels, escalation practices, performance expectations, and employee experience across locations.
* Responsible for hiring, performance management, development, and staffing decisions for these teams, and for oversight of contractors and managed service providers supporting these functions.

**Qualifications**
**Education/ Experience**
:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of experience and certifications.
* Ten or more years of progressively responsible IT infrastructure and operations experience, including at least five years managing technical teams.
* Hands-on background in Microsoft server and identity infrastructure, including Windows Server, Active Directory, and Microsoft 365, in an organization with at least 1,000 employees is preferred.
* Experience leading multiple IT functions, such as platform operations, network engineering, and service desk and field support, in a distributed, multi-site organization.
* Demonstrated success delivering infrastructure, network, or cloud modernization programs.
* Deep knowledge of Windows Server administration, Active Directory, Entra ID (Azure AD), ADFS, DNS/DHCP, and Windows and Azure security best practices.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft 365 administration, including Exchange Online, SharePoint, and Teams.
* Experience with virtualization platforms, enterprise storage, backup and recovery tools such as Rubrik, and/or Azure Site Recovery.
* Experience with Azure and AWS infrastructure and networking in a hybrid environment.
* Strong working knowledge of enterprise networking and network security, including Cisco and Meraki switching and wireless, Palo Alto firewalls, VPN, and WAN connectivity.
* Experience leading a Service Desk and IT service management team with defined service levels using an ITSM platform.
* Budget ownership and vendor management experience, including contract negotiation and telecom carrier management.
* Working knowledge of PCI, SOX, and related control and audit requirements.
* Experience with monitoring platforms such as Data Dog, PRTG, or similar enterprise monitoring and observability tools.
* PowerShell scripting, infrastructure-as-code, and automation experience.
* Experience with cloud-native network transit architectures, such as AWS Transit Gateway and Azure Virtual WAN, and migration away from virtual router appliances.
* ITIL 4 certification or equivalent IT service management training.
* Experience supporting retail, warehouse, or logistics operations, and managing geographically distributed, field, or contracted support teams.
* Relevant certifications such as Microsoft Azure Administrator or Solutions Architect, AWS, CCNP, PMP, or CISSP.

**Skills And Ability**

* Strong leader who builds accountable, high-performing teams
* Hands-on technical depth to step in on complex escalations
* Ability to balance day-to-day operational demands with long-term strategic initiatives and to manage multiple priorities under pressure
* Clear, confident written and verbal communication with technical teams, executives, and business stakeholders
* Sound judgment and composure when leading critical incidents
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, planning, and prioritization skills
* Customer-service mindset focused on the employee experience

Duties primarily involve prolonged periods of sitting, working on a computer, and communicating via phone and video conferencing.
* The employee must be able to frequently use a computer, keyboard, mouse, and other standard office equipment, as well as communicate effectively with colleagues, customers, and business partners. Occasional lifting of office materials or equipment up to 15 pounds may be required.

Title: Incident Manager
Description:
**About Peraton**
Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world's leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we're keeping people around the world safe and secure.
  
  
**About The Role**
Peraton is looking for an
**Incident Manager**
to join our Team. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong problem-solving, analytical, and organizational skills, with excellent time management and attention to detail. Effective written and verbal communication skills are key, with strong critical-thinking abilities, and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively as a team. These qualities are essential to successfully managing and resolving high-priority incidents in a fast-paced environment.
  
  
**Work Location:**
This is a remote position with core working hours of 8am - 5pm EST
  
  
**What You Will Do:**

* Lead the coordination and management of impacting incidents to ensure timely service restoration while minimizing disruption to customers and business operations.
* Execute the enterprise Incident Management process, including monitoring incident queues, prioritizing incidents, and coordinating escalations to drive timely resolution.
* Facilitate the global response and coordination of major incidents affecting mission-critical business applications and infrastructure services in a 24/7/365 environment.
* Lead major incident communications by providing timely, accurate, and consistent updates to customers, stakeholders, and leadership throughout the incident life-cycle.
* Review and validate major incident notifications to ensure communications are complete, accurate, and appropriate for the intended audience.
* Leverage incident and problem management tools to track incidents, maintain detailed incident logs, document resolutions, and prepare reports for management review.
* Apply technical knowledge across infrastructure, applications, security, and performance management to support incident investigation and resolution.
* Collaborate with technical teams, Service Desk personnel, and other stakeholders to troubleshoot complex hardware and software issues and drive incidents toward resolution.
* Identify recurring incidents and potential trends, partnering with Problem Management teams to support root cause analysis and prevent future disruptions.
* Drive continuous improvement of the Incident Management life-cycle, including incident response procedures, escalation processes, and post-incident reviews.
* Develop, maintain, and improve technical documentation, operational procedures, and process guidelines for the Incident Management team.
* Build and maintain strong relationships across the organization to support critical incidents, including high-profile business events and time-sensitive operations.
* Remain composed and effective in high-pressure situations while managing competing priorities and coordinating multiple teams during critical incidents.
* Participate in an on-call rotation and provide incident management support outside of standard business hours, as needed, to ensure 24/7 service coverage.
* Maintain flexibility in work schedule to support business needs and incident response requirements.

**Problem Management**

* Engage with and assist the Problem Management team during Problem Investigations
* Utilize problem management reports to validate if any open problem known errors when handling high-priority incidents.
* Proactively and reactively, look for solutions to prevent problems from occurring in team/technology area.

**Change Management/Implementation**

* Utilize change management reports during a high-priority incident to validate if incident could be caused by change.
* Independently review, implement, and verify changes/solutions of high complexity and risk to meet customer and/or trade/IT infrastructure needs.
* May participate in a Change Advisory Board.

**Customer Relationship Management**

* Becoming a trusted advisor to the customer.

**Teamwork**

* Work as part of a team, which may be virtual, global, and/or multi-functional.
* Lead teams which address operational processes and policies in work area.
* Seen as a resource to the team in one or more technical or business areas.
* Becoming a trusted advisor inside and outside the team/technology area.

**Qualifications**
**Basic Qualifications:**

* Must be a U.S. Citizen with the ability to obtain and maintain the required Public Trust level clearance
* Must be willing to undergo a pre-employment credit check as required by the Customer.
* Bachelor's Degree and 5 years of experience, a Master's Degree and 3 years of experience, an Associate's Degree and 7 years of experience, or a High School Diploma or equivalent and 9 years of experience
* 3+ years of relevant experience in Customer Service, Incident Management, or general project management
* Familiarity and understanding of IT Service Management tools (Remedy, JIRA, ServiceNow, etc.)
* Working knowledge of the technology, applications, and infrastructure within areas of responsibility
* Ability to effectively coordinate technical teams during incident investigation and resolution
* Developing and maintaining relationships with customers, vendors, and internal stakeholders to ensure effective communication, collaboration, and coordination throughout the incident management life-cycle
* Proficiency with MS Office: Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* ITIL Foundations Certification
* One or more of the following Incident Response related certifications: Threat Handling Foundations certificate, Certified in Cybersecurity (CC), Practical SOC Analyst Associate (PSAA), OffSec Incident Responder (OSIR), or Certified Incident Handler (ECIH)

**Details**
Target Salary Range: $51,000 - $82,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Responsibilities

- Experience with incident management and a blameless postmortem culture.
  
- Strong understanding of operational KPIs, SLAs, and system reliability engineering practices.
  
- Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with a track record of translating deeply technical issues into clear business impact summaries for leadership.

Title: Technical Program Manager-Data Center
Description:
**About the Role:**

The Technical Program Manager administers the qualification and validation of new products, and of retrofits and engineering changes to existing parts, for use in large-scale data center environments. The program spans inside plant (ISP) and outside plant (OSP) optical fiber cable, connectivity, and pathway products from candidate identification through validated, released configuration. The position owns the technical content of the program: product selection and evaluation criteria, test methodology, acceptance limits, measurement integrity, and the qualification record that supports product approval and release. The Technical Program Manager serves as the technical interface between design engineering, construction and installation crews, component manufacturers, and test equipment suppliers, and is accountable for validated, documented, and field-reproducible connectivity products on schedule.

**What You’ll Do:**

* **Validation Program Planning and Execution:** Develop and own integrated validation program plans covering both new product introduction and retrofits or engineering changes to existing parts — qualification sequence, entry and exit criteria, material and laboratory dependencies, and decision gates — holding the critical path and driving programs to documented closure.
* **Inside Plant and Outside Plant Infrastructure:** Manage ISP structured cabling across backbone and horizontal distribution, riser and plenum pathways, main and intermediate distribution frames (MDF/IDF), cabinet and rack-mounted patch fields, fiber distribution frames, splice and termination enclosures, cassette-based modular patching, cable tray, basket and innerduct pathway, and firestopping and pathway segregation; and OSP placement across duct bank and conduit, microduct and air-blown fiber, maintenance holes and handholes, aerial and direct-buried routes, building entrance facilities and points of entry (MPOE), transition splice points, armored and dielectric constructions, and environmental and ingress protection at the ISP/OSP demarcation.
* **Fiber Cable, Connectivity, and Termination Scope:** Qualify single-mode (OS2, 9/125 µm) and multimode cable across the full range of standard counts in general industry use, from 24-fiber distribution cable through 3456-fiber high-count backbone, in loose tube, central core, ribbon, rollable ribbon, and 200/250 µm coating designs, evaluating diameter, bend radius, pulling tension, duct fill, and mid-span access against pathway and installation constraints. Own connectivity across LC and LC duplex, MTP/MPO single-row and dual-row arrays (8, 12, 16, and 24 fiber), and very-high-density MMC arrays (16 and 24 fiber), including pinned (male) and unpinned (female) configurations, UPC and APC endface geometries, gender and key orientation, and polarity schemes spanning TIA-568 Method A, B, and C and the conventions applicable to multi-row arrays. Define and validate patch panel, cassette, adapter plate, and shelf configurations for port density, fiber management, bend radius protection, slack storage, labeling access, and serviceability, and evaluate breakout, fanout, harness, trunk, and pigtail assemblies against port mapping and channel performance requirements.
* **Test, Measurement, and Acceptance:** Establish and govern optical test programs — Tier 1 optical loss test set (OLTS) insertion loss and return loss certification, Tier 2 OTDR characterization, bidirectional testing, length and continuity verification, polarity and fitment verification, and endface inspection and cleaning to recognized criteria such as IEC 61300-3-35 — controlling test reference cord (TRC) grade, referencing method, and calibration state so results are repeatable and defensible. Reconcile measured channel performance against design acceptance criteria and transceiver link specifications, and drive corrective action where acceptance limits are not met.
* **Supplier Qualification and Test Equipment Capability:** Lead technical qualification of cable, connectivity, and pathway manufacturers through sample submission, first-article inspection, mechanical and optical evaluation, failure analysis, root cause determination, and corrective action closure, maintaining a defensible qualification record and a clear statement of remaining gaps per supplier. Evaluate, select, and introduce fiber test and inspection platforms end to end, covering technical evaluation against requirements, procurement support, asset control and inventory, calibration and reference cord management, operator training, and fleet distribution to regional field crews.
* **Documentation and Standards:** Produce and sustain installation work instructions, test procedures, golden samples, first-of-kind build documentation, labeling and administration schemes, and as-built records, maintaining them so methods are applied consistently by field crews and subcontractors without procedural drift.
* **Program Governance and Risk Management:** Maintain accurate program status, ownership, target dates, and documented reasons for schedule movement, and produce recurring technical status reporting for client and internal leadership, surfacing aging, blocked, and unassigned work rather than allowing it to persist. Identify technical, schedule, supply chain, and capability risks in advance, quantify impact, drive mitigation to a named owner and committed date, and escalate with a recommendation.
* **Safety and Regulatory Compliance:** Champion a zero-injury culture in laboratory and field environments, ensuring personnel and subcontractors understand and apply laser safety, confined space, excavation, aerial work, and fiber handling requirements, and that work complies with OSHA and other applicable regulations and site access requirements.

**What You’ll Need:**

* Knowledge and use of basic telecom hand tools.
* Must understand customer service.

* Reports to Operations Manager and take daily directions from Technician, Technician II, Lead Technicians, Senior Technicians and Advance Senior Technicians.

Description:
**OUR COMPANY BACKGROUND & CULTURE**

  

UPP is the first pension plan of its kind in Ontario’s university sector, proudly serving over 46,000 members across six universities and nineteen sector organizations. We believe diverse teams, perspectives, and lived experiences contribute to better decisions and a better workplace. As UPP celebrates its fifth anniversary, we’re proud to be recognized for our efforts:

  

  
* 2026 Greater Toronto’s Top 100 Employers

Join us in building a bright future for our members, our organization, and each other.

**THE ROLE**

  

We are seeking a proactive and outcomes-focused Manager, Service Management to oversee the performance, governance, and continuous improvement of our Managed Service Provider (MSP) and service management practice.  This position plays a critical role in overseeing the performance and governance of our Managed Service Provider (MSP), ensuring the delivery of resilient and reliable IT services including O365, workloads hosted on Google Cloud Platform, third-party cloud systems, infrastructure, and execution of core ITIL processes.

  

Reporting directly to the Director, Technology & Security Operations, the Manager will lead service governance, major incident coordination, and process improvement initiatives across ITIL disciplines, while also supporting technology continuity planning and operational readiness.

  

This is a fantastic opportunity for an experienced service management professional to join a team of high-performing individuals and make a great impact in a fast-paced organization.  

  

This role is based in downtown Toronto in a hybrid work environment, allowing employees the flexibility to work remotely and in-office (minimum two days per week in-office).

  

This posting is for a existing vacancy.

  

**SPECIFIC ACCOUNTABILITIES**

  

The Manager, Service Management will be responsible for a variety of duties, including but not limited to the following:

  

  
* Manage MSP performance against agreed service levels, KPIs, financial measures and contractual commitments, addressing gaps that could affect service quality, cost or user experience.
  
* Turn service data into business insight by reporting on availability, response and resolution times, ticket quality and other key measures to support leadership decisions.

* Maintain effective escalation arrangements by keeping system contact paths current and ensuring the MSP follows clear escalation procedures and role assignments for critical incidents.
  
* Strengthen post-incident outcomes by facilitating reviews, validating root cause analyses and tracking actions that reduce the risk of recurrence.
  
* Review and approve changes through the CAB by confirming business readiness, risk controls and alignment with service and operational requirements.
  
* Keep operational procedures current and usable so internal teams and service partners can follow consistent, approved ways of working.
  
* Support technology continuity and recovery by helping maintain, test and improve disaster recovery plans to protect critical business services.
  
* Use service trends to identify improvement opportunities and lead initiatives with internal teams and the MSP that improve reliability, efficiency and user experience.
  
* Build strong working relationships across the organization to align service delivery with business expectations, operational priorities and user needs.
  

  

**QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE**

  

  
* 10+ years of experience in IT service management, preferably within hybrid or federated delivery models.
  
* 5+ years managing an IT Managed Service Provider, including setting clear expectations, monitoring performance against contracts and service levels, resolving delivery gaps, and driving accountability for results.
  
* Strong knowledge of ITIL 4 and a track record of improving service management practices to strengthen reliability, efficiency and the user experience.
  
* Experience leading innovation and continuous improvement, identifying opportunities to use automation, monitoring and service data to improve outcomes and reduce recurring effort.
  
* Demonstrated ability to lead major incidents, coordinating distributed teams and vendors, communicating clearly with stakeholders, and driving timely service restoration.
  
* Experience advancing ServiceNow capabilities for service workflows, dashboards, monitoring, ticket management and performance reporting.
  
* Experience supporting disaster recovery exercises, coordinating the collection and validation of system evidence and tracking follow-up actions.
  
* Strong planning and estimation skills, including assessing initiative scope, dependencies, effort and timelines, and communicating delivery expectations.
  
* Excellent documentation and communication skills, including the ability to present service performance, risks and improvement plans to senior stakeholders.
  
* Experience working across business units to build understanding, adoption and consistent use of operational processes.
  
* ITIL 4 Foundation or higher certification; familiarity with ISO 27001, NIST or COBIT frameworks.
  

  

**ATTRIBUTES**

  

  
* Takes initiative, follows through reliably and works independently while keeping stakeholders informed.
  
* Communicates clearly and effectively with business leaders, technical teams and service providers.
  
* Builds practical, repeatable processes that improve service consistency and accountability.
  
* Organizes and aligns contributions from multiple teams to deliver agreed outcomes.
  
* Anticipates issues, investigates root causes and takes action to resolve them.
  
* Uses data and sound judgment to assess performance, identify risks and guide decisions.
  
* Combines a hands-on approach with the ability to set clear expectations and hold the MSP accountable for results.
  
* Looks for opportunities to innovate and continuously improve service quality, efficiency and user experience.
  
* Monitors relevant technologies, trends, threats, standards and products, and recommends changes that strengthen the organization’s security posture and support business needs.

We are duty-bound to serve our members’ interests, and it’s a responsibility we don’t take lightly. That’s why we’ve ingrained sustainability in our work from day one—to ensure our members have a resilient future to retire into, both today and for generations to come.

Title: Major Incident Manager, Incident Management
Description:
**Responsibilities**
The USDS JV Incident Management Team (IMT) is a critical pillar within the US Tech and Product organization, dedicated to ensuring the resilience and reliability of TikTok’s U.S. Data Security infrastructure. As a security-first division, we focus on providing specialized oversight and protection for U.S. user data and the platforms that support them.
  
While global teams monitor overall service health, the IMT is uniquely positioned to manage the "blast radius" within the USDS environment. We act as the bridge between technical engineering teams (SRE, Infrastructure, Platform) and business stakeholders, ensuring that every major incident is handled with the precision and urgency required by our unique operating environment.
  
  
As a Major Incident Manager, you will be at the forefront of protecting the TikTok experience for millions of users. You will join a cohesive, proficient team committed to upholding the highest standards of professionalism and technical expertise, directly contributing to the safety and security of the U.S. digital ecosystem.
  
  
Responsibilities
  
- Incident Command: Lead the end-to-end response for high-severity incidents, driving rapid restoration of service while coordinating across cross-functional engineering teams.
  
- Stakeholder Communication: Craft and deliver clear, timely, and accurate communication updates to internal stakeholders, executive leadership, and customer-facing teams during critical events.
  
- Post-Incident Reviews: Facilitate blameless post-mortems, ensuring root causes are thoroughly identified, actionable remediation items are tracked, and lessons learned are shared globally.
  
- Dashboarding & Visibility: Create and maintain real-time operational dashboards that provide high visibility into system health, incident trends, and key reliability metrics (MTTD/MTTR).
  
- Continuous Improvement: Analyze incident data and operational metrics to identify systemic trends, driving initiatives to reduce Mean Time to Detect (MTTD) and Mean Time to Resolution (MTTR).
  
- Team Process Evolution: Manage and optimize the incident management rotation, refining playbooks, alerting thresholds, and escalation pathways for the SRE org.
  
- Alerting & Monitoring Improvements: Partner with SRE and development teams to continuously refine alert thresholds, reduce alert fatigue, and ensure high-severity pages are highly actionable.
  
- Automation Engineering: Design and build automated workflows to streamline incident response, such as automated stakeholder communications, auto-remediation scripts, and tool integrations.
  
- Oncall Support: This position provides on-call support and requires working scheduled shifts, which may include holidays. The scheduled shift is Sunday to Thursday, from 5:00 PM to 2:00 AM PT.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Minimum Qualifications
  
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience) with 4+ years of experience in Incident Management, Production Support, or SRE/Operations within a large-scale SaaS or cloud environment.
  
- Strong understanding of cloud computing concepts (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and modern infrastructure architectures (microservices, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines).
  
- Hands-on experience configuring and refining alerts and monitoring templates using industry-standard tools (e.g., Grafana, Splunk, Prometheus, New Relic).
  
- Ability to write scripts (e.g., Bash, Python) or use low-code integration tools to automate repetitive incident management tasks and notification pipelines.
  
- Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with a track record of translating deeply technical issues into clear business impact summaries for leadership.
  
- Strong working knowledge of ITIL incident management frameworks or modern DevOps/SRE incident response practices.
  
  
Preferred Qualifications
  
- 5+ years of experience in Incident Management, Production Support, or SRE/Operations within a large-scale SaaS or cloud environment.
  
- Deep alignment with Google SRE principles, including Error Budgets, SLA/SLO/SLI management, and automation-first mindsets.
  
- Proven experience implementing ChatOps, auto-remediation workflows, or Event-Driven Ansible/Runbook automation to programmatically resolve common alerts.
  
- Advanced proficiency with modern incident orchestration platforms like PagerDuty, Opsgenie, JIRA Service Management, and Slack integrations.
  
- Experience using SQL, Tableau, or similar data visualization tools to build operational dashboards and report on organizational reliability metrics.
  
- Relevant industry certifications such as ITIL v4, AWS/GCP Certified Professional, or Certified Incident Commander.
  
- Experience coaching and training engineering teams on best practices for on-call hygiene and conducting constructive post-mortems.

Title: Senior Manager, Enterprise Data & Cloud Modernization
Description:
**Job Description**

  

**Vacancy Status:** This posting is for a new vacancy within the organization and is open to new applications.

**AI Disclosure:** As part of the application process, Artificial Intelligence will be used in the hiring process for this role

This role is categorized as hybrid. This means the successful candidate is expected to report to the Markham Elevation Centre or the Oshawa Elevation Centre at least three times per week.

  

**The Team & Opportunity**
--------------------------

  

The Enterprise Data team is responsible for supporting and modernizing the data platforms that enable analytics, artificial intelligence, customer engagement, strategic planning, and other enterprise capabilities across GM.

  

We are building a new team to support the existing legacy environment while migrating and transforming the architecture to a cloud-based platform. This role will help establish the engineering standards, reusable platform capabilities, delivery automation, and operational practices required for a secure, scalable, governed, and reliable cloud data ecosystem.

  

The ideal candidate is a strategic, hands-on technology leader with a track record of operating and modernizing complex enterprise data environments. They can lead multidisciplinary teams across data engineering, business analysis, data quality, and governance; align business and technology stakeholders around a clear modernization roadmap; and deliver large-scale migration while protecting the reliability of existing services. They understand how to build trusted, well-governed data foundations that enable enterprise-wide analytics and AI adoption.

  

**The Role**
------------

As the Senior Manager, Enterprise Data & Cloud Modernization, you will lead the team responsible for the day-to-day health and continued operation of the existing enterprise data warehouse, as well as its modernization and migration to a cloud-based environment. You will set direction, establish delivery and operational priorities, and ensure the platform evolves to meet the needs of GM Canada and the wider enterprise.

You will lead a multidisciplinary team comprising three Data Engineering, Cloud Migration & Platforms Engineers; one Business Analyst, Enterprise Data & Cloud Migration; one Data Validation & Data Quality Analyst, Enterprise Data; and one Data Governance Analyst. You will bring these capabilities together into a coordinated operating model that delivers reliable services, high-quality and well-governed data, and a successful migration. The cloud implementation may be Azure/Databricks, Google Cloud Platform, or another direction based on platform and business requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Set the vision, strategy, roadmap, and operating priorities for the enterprise data environment, balancing current service needs with modernization and migration objectives.
* Lead and develop a multidisciplinary team across data engineering, business analysis, data validation and quality, and data governance; clarify accountability, establish expectations, and support professional growth.
* Maintain the reliability, availability, performance, security, and supportability of the existing enterprise data warehouse and its critical data pipelines.
* Lead the planning and execution of the enterprise data warehouse migration to a cloud-based environment, including scope, sequencing, dependencies, risks, resourcing, milestones, and business readiness.
* Direct modernization of data architecture, platforms, pipelines, processes, and controls to improve scalability, automation, resilience, maintainability, and cost effectiveness.
* Establish a practical transition strategy that protects business continuity, manages legacy and cloud coexistence, and ensures migrated workloads and data meet agreed operational and business requirements.
* Ensure migration outcomes are validated through appropriate testing, reconciliation, data-quality controls, business acceptance, and production-readiness reviews.
* Set expectations for engineering standards and practices, including architecture, automation, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, testing, observability, incident response, and documentation.
* Establish and oversee data-quality practices that monitor completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, and schema conformance across source, pipeline, and warehouse data.
* Lead data governance practices that support clear ownership, stewardship, definitions, metadata, lineage, access controls, classification, retention, and responsible use of enterprise data.
* Build trusted relationships with business leaders, GM Canada stakeholders, enterprise data consumers, technology partners, security and risk teams, and global platform organizations.
* Translate business priorities into a sequenced and measurable data roadmap, ensuring stakeholder needs and downstream impacts are represented in decisions.
* Oversee requirements management, backlog priorities, sprint and release planning, delivery tracking, risk and issue management, and cross-team dependencies.
* Establish clear measures of success for platform health, service reliability, migration progress, data quality, governance, delivery outcomes, and customer or business impact.
* Ensure operational procedures, support models, escalation paths, service expectations, runbooks, and knowledge transfer are in place for both legacy and cloud environments.
* Promote a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and data-informed decision-making across the team.
* Guide the development of secure, trusted, discoverable, and well-documented data foundations that can support analytics, artificial intelligence, and enterprise-wide AI adoption.
Communicate progress, decisions, risks, trade-offs, and outcomes clearly to senior stakeholders and delivery partners.  

**Required Qualifications and Skills**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Management, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Significant progressive experience leading enterprise data, data engineering, data platforms, technology modernization, or related functions.
* Demonstrated experience leading multidisciplinary teams and delivering complex, enterprise-scale data or technology initiatives.
* Experience operating and modernizing enterprise data warehouses and production data platforms, preferably including Oracle-based environments.
* Proven ability to lead large-scale data platform or warehouse migrations, from assessment and planning through implementation, validation, and operational transition.
